verdict.rationale: Zep documents a single-call, scope='auto' context retrieval that dynamically composes relevant edges, nodes, episodes, and thread summaries into a ready-to-use context block, retrievable directly via thread.add_messages() or a dedicated call, with sub-200ms latency claims. This directly matches the story of a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block from one call. missing for 10: explicit documentation of token-budget controls/limits on the block, and independent (non-vendor) benchmarking of latency/quality claims.
